text: Professor Oak's lab is open: once your Pokédex holds 10 species, spend your research points in four skill trees.
A hint on every silhouette, and four mastery bonuses for each species you fully research.
Pokédex research: every species has its challenges, which earn research points and raise its stage.
Zones and feeder: your Pokémon gather berries and apricorns, and the feeder lures the types you are after.
The Ranch opens: a wild Pokémon comes by every hour, even while you are away.
